22.scope_review: Cashier departure before completion of customer service; located in the cash receipt section. Requires reliable operation and temporal context.

42.scope_review: Supervision of counting, sorting and packing, with an explicit exception for receiving or paying cash to a customer. A missing person in frame does not prove absence.

55.scope_review: Locking and sealing cassettes for automatic devices; does not apply to every cash drawer. Observe completion of preparation before assigning a breach.
